method: Trackers: Committee of 100 (2023 report Table 1; July 2026 map page), Make Us Visible state chapters, K-12 Dive, Northwest Asian Weekly. Search quota ran out before per-state checks of 2025-26 bills in remaining states; 'none' means not found in these trackers.

notes: Search quota ran out mid-run. 2025-26 bill status was directly checked only for AK, AZ, MD, MA, NY, WA, ME, DE. Other 'none' states rest on trackers (C100 2023 and July 2026, Make Us Visible, K-12 Dive); C100 says 7 states have pending bills as of July 23, 2026 but its state list is in a Shiny map I could not read, so some pending bills may be missed.

Tracker disagreement on counts: C100 (July 2026) says 13 states have Asian American studies statutes; its 2023 report named 11 (CA, CO, CT, FL, IL, NE, NV, NJ, OR, RI, UT). Make Us Visible counts 8 mandate states (IL, NJ, CT, RI, FL, WI, DE, ME) and omits CA, CO, NE, NV, OR, UT. This table: 11 enacted, 15 partial, 1 pending, 24 none.

Classification calls: CA, CO, NE, NV, OR are enacted because the statute names Asian American and/or Pacific Islander history inside a required curriculum or standards, though as part of multi-group lists. UT is partial (ethnic studies mandate; AAPI named only in a definition). DE and ME are partial (see cells); MUV counts both as mandates.

Standards-only states (AL, AZ, IN, MN, MS, TN, VA, DC from C100 2023 data; OK and IA from C100 July 2026) are marked partial because C100 calls the standards required curriculum. I did not open any state standards document, and the 2023 list may be stale. C100 says 17 states have such standards in 2026; I can name 15 states plus DC (AL, AZ, CA, CT, FL, HI, IN, MA, MN, MS, OK, OR, TN, VA, IA); the other 2 are unidentified.

Hawaii: no statute found; the Hawaiian education program mandate is in Haw. Const. art. X sec. 4 and covers Native Hawaiian language, culture and history only. Marked partial under the lower-status rule. Hawaii statute pages were blocked (Cloudflare) so implementing statutes could not be searched.

Primary text not reached: Connecticut statute text (cga.ct.gov TLS error; relied on CSDE page and news), Illinois statute page (ilga.gov TLS error; Public Act and ISBE page read through the fetch tool), Wisconsin statute (read via the fetch tool, not directly). Several quotes (IL, CT, WI, NY) come from page text as relayed by the fetch tool.

Dead or stalled bills noted as none: AK SB 6 (Senate-passed 2025, House Finance 2026), AZ SB 1301 (held in House 2025; AZ is partial for standards), MD HB 1323 (2025) and HB 1059 (2026), WA SB 5574 (died Feb 2026). Adjournment dates were not confirmed on a fetched page. Massachusetts H.604 is the only bill I confirmed as still sitting in committee.

New Jersey: chapter is numbered P.L. 2021 c. 416 but approval date is 1/18/2022; y is set to 2022 (C100 says 2021). Delaware regulation update under SB 297 and Maine's July 2029 effective date are not verified beyond the session-law text.
Utah 2026 HB 399 (would have restructured 53E-4-204.1) has no enrolled version at le.utah.gov, so it appears not to have passed; Utah's ethnic studies section was last amended in 2025.
